text:
emma: canary failing in ap-south after key alias rotation at 02:10 UTC
oliver: seeing repeated TLS alert 40 on edge-proxy logs, cert validation error: backend decrypt failed
raj: why was alias `alias/service-proxy` repointed across regions? I thought rotation script only touches metadata
oliver: the rotation job (helm hook) updated alias to point to key ARN in eu-west instead of ap-south by mistake
grace: that explains cross-region decrypt attempts -> kms returns InvalidCiphertext when key region mismatch
audit-bot: sampling policy shows mtls_event sampling set to 5% globally; recent deploys lowered sampling for proxies to 1%
infra-oncall: impact: 40 failed handshakes in ap-south over 6m, fallback to soft-terminate observed for some upstreams
emma: rollback alias now? we need quick restore for customer traffic
raj: run `aws kms update-alias --alias-name alias/service-proxy --target-key-id <correct-key-id>` pointing to ap-south key ARN
oliver: doing `aws kms list-aliases --region ap-south-1 | grep service-proxy` to confirm; hold for 60s then watch handshakes
infra-oncall: alias updated 02:16 UTC, proxies resumed. handshakes dropped to normal within 45s
grace: root cause: rotation job pr used global alias resolution that didn't account for region-scoped keys. PR: #4123 changed alias assignment logic
emma: immediate fix: revert PR and add region guard, and add unit tests that simulate multi-region aliases
raj: longer term: policy change — forbid cross-region aliasing via CI lint and add KMS policy condition `kms:SourceAccount` and `kms:EncryptionContext:region` check where possible
audit-bot: recommendation: increase mtls_event sampling to 20% in ap-south for next 12h and preserve full cloudtrail for keys touched for 30d (not default 7d)
oliver: where is sampling configured? observability -> audit-config -> samplingRules -> proxy-events
grace: I can push a one-off sampling override: `POST /api/v1/audit/sampling override { "match":"event:mtls && region:ap-south", "rate":0.2, "expires":"2026-03-22T14:16:00Z" }`
infra-oncall: capture logs for postmortem: edge-proxy logs, helm release diffs, KMS cloudtrail entries, rotation job logs, CI run for #4123
emma: creating incident INC-2026-0471 and assigning postmortem to @oliver and @raj
raj: action items: (1) revert PR + patch region guard (2) add CI lint to block cross-region alias changes (3) sampling override + extend cloudtrail retention for affected keys (4) add canary that exercises KMS alias update in each region during rollout
oliver: I'll author canary job: small job that rotates alias to a staging key and runs decrypt path; schedule in staging and then run before prod rotation
grace: also suggest a playbook step: validate `aws kms describe-key --key-id` region matches expected and alert if mismatch
audit-bot: logged incident and recommended artifacts list attached to ticket
emma: thanks team, follow-up sync tomorrow 09:30 UTC to review postmortem draft :thumbsup:
